verdict.rationale: First-party docs say the CLI runs the entire Supabase stack locally or in CI via `supabase init` and `supabase start`, and the local stack also exposes the MCP server at localhost:54321. Hands-on probes confirm the CLI installs and scaffolds a project headlessly, and Docker Compose self-hosting is documented. Community users call local development and migrations a weak spot with "random bugs", which lowers quality and confidence but does not show the capability failing to work. Missing for 10: hands-on verification that `supabase start` actually brings up all services, independent corroboration of a smooth local-to-deploy workflow, and detail on per-service parity between the local stack and the hosted platform.
